scripts.check: node --input-type=module -e "import { readdirSync } from 'node:fs'; import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; const files = readdirSync('public/js').filter((file) => file.endsWith('.js')).sort(); for (const file of files) { const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--check', 'public/js/' + file], { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (result.status !== 0) process.exit(result.status ?? 1); } console.log('Syntax check passed for ' + files.length + ' JavaScript modules.');"
